summary: Bind Cloud KMS use/provider/rotation/destruction receipts to immutable metadata-only evidence events. Domain receipts now convert to private event/receipt carriers with tenant, key id, actor, operation, status, evidence ref, occurred timestamp, schema version, and optional provider/key-version metadata while rejecting tenant drift, provider drift, schema drift, token-shaped evidence refs, and raw material/ciphertext references.

baseline_diff.before: Cloud KMS produced use receipts, provider crypto receipts, rotation state changes, and destruction proofs, but there was no canonical metadata-only evidence event type for audit-chain handoff across those receipt families.
baseline_diff.after: Cloud KMS domain owns CloudKmsEvidenceEvent and CloudKmsEvidenceReceipt carriers plus KeyRotationReceipt generation; each receipt family maps to metadata-only evidence and rejects raw material refs, ciphertext refs, token-shaped refs, wrong tenants/providers, and schema-version drift before evidence emission.

repo_authority_used.establishes: KMS root key custody and per-cell HSM partition activity must be auditable without leaking tenant key material across cell boundaries.
Residency and evidence decisions use cell/tenant audit surfaces and hard-stop on conflicting placement evidence.

CS-CLOUD-KMS-003 requires KMS use/rotation/destruction/provider receipts to convert to immutable metadata-only evidence events with schema version, tenant, key id, actor, operation, status, evidence ref, and occurred timestamp.

implementation_notes: Kept evidence conversion in the KMS domain kernel; no adapter or API path performs audit-chain I/O in this slice.
Added KeyRotationRequest/KeyRotationReceipt and rotate_with_receipt without replacing the existing rotate API, limiting downstream churn while making receipt-backed rotation available.
Evidence events deliberately store evidence refs and metadata only; they do not expose material_ref, ciphertext_ref, provider credentials, plaintext, or key bytes.
Provider evidence conversion validates the expected provider, preserving a stable adapter boundary and avoiding provider receipt replay across OpenBao and OCI evidence streams.
Destruction evidence uses the existing destruction proof ref as evidence_ref and a system actor for control-plane destruction events because existing destruction receipts do not carry an actor.

findings: The slice adds receipt-to-evidence conversion and a receipt-backed rotation method without introducing audit-chain I/O or new provider abstractions.
KMS evidence is metadata-only and tenant/provider/schema-bound, making it safe for audit-chain handoff without raw key material exposure.
Negative tests cover tenant mismatch, provider mismatch, schema drift, token-shaped evidence refs, and raw material/ciphertext ref rejection.
Evidence event getters expose metadata needed by API/audit callers while keeping event fields private.
RED/GREEN domain tests, full KMS package tests, clippy, fmt, and gates passed.

alternatives_named: Emit audit-chain JSON directly from adapters
Reuse raw provider receipts as evidence events
Map domain receipts into metadata-only evidence events
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Domain-owned metadata conversion preserves clean architecture and prevents raw provider/material references from becoming the audit-chain contract.
rejected_reasons: Adapter emission would couple provider translators to audit storage.
Raw provider receipts contain material/ciphertext refs and provider-specific fields not safe as the canonical evidence event shape.

findings: Evidence refs reject matref/, ct/, token-shaped values, spaces, controls, tenant drift, and provider drift.
Evidence conversion is local metadata validation and string normalization; no network, HSM, or provider I/O is introduced.
Receipt conversion gives rotation/destruction/provider crypto/use flows an audit-ready metadata event shape.
The change is isolated to KMS domain evidence carriers plus API error mapping; rollback is a single ChangeSet revert.
Events include deterministic operation, status, occurred timestamp, and evidence refs for later audit-chain persistence.
Existing rotation call remains available; receipt-backed rotation is opt-in for callers that need evidence.
Clean architecture remains intact: domain owns evidence event invariants, API only maps new errors, adapters remain deterministic provider translators.

remaining_risks: Actual audit-chain persistence remains outside this domain slice; this change produces local metadata carriers only.
API response surfaces do not yet expose the new evidence events; that belongs to later app/API/audit-chain wiring.
Cloud KMS manifest still overclaims some capability/SLO/DR surfaces and is deferred to CS-CLOUD-KMS-004.
